name: example-exercise
description: Example ATT&CK Navigator layer for `forge from-exercise`. A hand-written stand-in for the output of a BAS exercise (bas-purple-team-exercise). Mixes techniques the PurpleForge catalog can build (they become the lab's intentional gaps) with runtime-only TTPs it cannot (reported as uncovered, never silently dropped). Only `techniqueID` matters; colors/scores/comments are ignored.
